page.title: How to earn/use credits
page.description: Welcome to the PropertyList Credit System guide. Learn how to navigate our flexible, pay-as-you-go infrastructure. This guide explains how to earn your free verified agency bonus, purchase credits, and strategically deploy them to unlock premium features - from AI Utility Agents to XML website exports
page.body:
Get paid visibility - only when you need it


No monthly traps. No wasted fees. Just credits that work like cash for deal-making.


Use our free core tools forever - then deploy credits to accelerate the moments that win listings, speed up sales, and turn browsers into buyers.

Fast summary - what you get:

  • 1 Credit = €1. No expiry. No hidden fees.
  • 20 free Credits on Verified Agency onboarding - try premium features risk-free.
  • Pay-As-You-Go flexibility: buy exactly what you need, when you need it.
  • Start small: Minimum top-up of 10 Credits (€10) lets you feature one listing immediately.


How credits help you close more deals

Imagine closing your next high-value listing faster: feature the property for 72 hours, generate a branded AI CMA in minutes, and send the winning report to the vendor - all paid from your credits wallet. That’s how credits turn effort into sales.


How the system works - step-by-step

  1. Buy or earn credits
    Welcome Bonus: 20 free Credits after Verified Agency onboarding.
    Pay-As-You-Go: top up instantly from your dashboard - bulk discounts available.
    Monthly plans: recurring credit allocations for premium features (coming soon).
  2. Redeem credits for real seller outcomes
    Feature a Listing (MLS): 10 Credits → Top search visibility for 72 hours.
    XML Website Export: 35 Credits / month (or €250 / year) → Automatically push your full inventory to your agency website so buyers always see current listings.
    AI Market Analysis (CMA): 5 Credits → Branded Comparative Market Analysis reports you can send to vendors in minutes. (First 2 free.)
  3. Track ROI in real time
    See how many extra views, leads, and vendor approvals you earned per campaign - then scale the tactics that pay.


Why agents prefer credits

Credits make marketing measurable: you only spend on actions that move deals. Use free tools to build trust, deploy credits to seal the sale.

Soft proof: Featured listings often receive multiple extra agent views in the first 72 hours.


Smart usage playbook

  • Don’t let a single qualified lead cool off because you waited. Use credits to:
  • Boost newly-listed, high-margin properties immediately (10 Credits for 72 hours).
  • Deliver branded CMAs to nervous owners and secure listing agreements (5 Credits).
  • Keep your website inventory fresh and indexed with XML export (35 Credits / month).


Terms - short, transparent

  • Credits are purchased in euros; 1 Credit = €1.
  • Credits do not expire.
  • Purchases are non-refundable.
  • No setup fees or hidden contracts.


Frequently Asked Questions


Q: How long until credits are available?

A: Credits appear instantly after payment and are visible in your dashboard.


Q: What payment methods do you accept?

A: Card and bank transfer (SEPA). Receipts are sent by email.


Q: Do credits expire?

A: No — credits never expire.


Q: Can I get a refund?

A: Purchases are non-refundable. If you have an issue, contact support.


Q: How do I become a Verified Agency?

A: Quick verification steps — Verify now.


Ready to see the difference?


Top up your credits now and watch your next listing climb to the top of searches.

Top up securely by card or bank transfer — credits appear instantly in your dashboard.
